name: Hotel Montjola
beschreibung: Hotel Montjola enjoys a tranquil location in St. Anton am Arlberg within Tyrol's Landeck district. The property blends classic alpine design with a relaxed, comfortable ambiance. In winter, it serves as an exceptional launchpad for exploring the world-famous Ski Arlberg slopes, while summer brings high-altitude hiking trails and cycling routes. Amenities include an inviting wellness area with sauna, sports equipment storage, and a regional restaurant.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Montjola in St. Anton am Arlberg provides peaceful alpine comfort, a sauna wellness area, regional dining, and direct access to world-renowned Ski Arlberg.
